person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: A DIAGNOSTIC CLASSIFICATION REVISING ITSELF IN PUBLIC - the fourteenth biennial Banff conference, which changed the criteria for two categories of kidney transplant rejection, named each revision by its meeting year, and published a survey of how its own users apply the previous version
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether inflammation in areas of fibrosis and atrophy (i-IFTA) should be admitted to the classification as diagnostic of chronic active TCMR, and at what thresholds
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the 2017 revisions: tubulointerstitial criteria for chronic active TCMR added at i-IFTA 2-3 with tubulitis t2-3, ABMR criteria widened to admit C4d and validated molecular assays as alternatives to donor-specific antibodies, and the word `acute` deleted from the ABMR category names
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: method
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a controlled vocabulary whose own authors apply it non-uniformly, revised by consensus every two years against evidence that arrives between meetings
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: consensus meeting with working groups, each reporting a remit and a survey of current practice; revisions adopted into a published working classification
span.term: consensus meeting with working groups, each reporting a remit and a survey of current practice; revisions adopted into a published working classification
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE VOCABULARY'S OWN AUTHORS DO NOT APPLY IT UNIFORMLY, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO IN ITS OWN WORKING-GROUP REPORT: `Survey among renal pathologists (INCLUDING VERY EXPERIENCED) revealed NONUNIFORM APPLICATION OF CURRENT BANFF TCMR CUTOFFS, consideration of NON-BANFF LESIONS in TCMR diagnosis, grading or nongrading of i-IFTA.` This corpus has records of vocabularies that failed on measurement (laubach2018) and of definitions that disagreed across papers; this is a body measuring the DISPERSION OF ITS OWN USERS and printing the result
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A WORD WAS REMOVED FROM THE CLASSIFICATION FOR A COMMUNICATIVE REASON, NOT A SCIENTIFIC ONE: `The term `ACUTE` (in acute/active ABMR) IS CONFUSING TO CLINICIANS, and consequently IT HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM THE BANFF CLASSIFICATION`. Nothing about the disease changed. The term was deleted because readers misread it - the same shape as macdonald2015 (WHO SAGE taking the narrower name for the broader concept for institutional reasons) and the ICTV's published change types, and the plainest case in the corpus of a definition edited for its AUDIENCE
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE SURVEY SAYS HOW THE VOCABULARY IS MISREAD, NOT ONLY THAT IT IS: `Clinicians often FAIL TO RECOGNIZE CHRONIC ELEMENTS OF ABMR (eg, cg >0)` and are `MORE LIKELY TO CONSIDER A DIAGNOSIS OF CHRONIC, ACTIVE ABMR IF C4d IS NEGATIVE, EVEN IF THERE IS NO TG, PTCBML, OR IFTA`. A named direction of error against a named criterion
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A FEATURE EXCLUDED IN 1991 WAS ADMITTED IN 2017 BECAUSE THE POPULATION CHANGED, NOT THE FEATURE: `The NONSPECIFICITY of i-IFTA for rejection, PROVED BY THE FACT THAT IT OCCURS IN NATIVE KIDNEYS, was the MAIN REASON WHY i-IFTA and tubulitis in atrophic tubules WAS SPECIFICALLY EXCLUDED FROM THE CLASSIFICATION AT THE FIRST BANFF MEETING. However, SINCE 1991, IMMUNOSUPPRESSION HAS CHANGED and graft survival improved with more patients presenting late posttransplantation with i-IFTA.` The lesion is exactly as nonspecific as it was; what moved is who gets biopsied
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A CATEGORY WAS DELIBERATELY NOT CREATED, BECAUSE ITS ANALOGUE PROVED UNDEFINABLE: `there is NO BORDERLINE OR SUSPICIOUS CATEGORY for chronic active TCMR, particularly as THIS CATEGORY WITHIN ACUTE TCMR HAS PROVED TO BE TROUBLESOME FOR TREATING CLINICIANS AND EVEN FOR PATHOLOGISTS TO DEFINE`. An absence with a stated reason - a committee declining to mint a term because the existing one of that shape does not work
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A LABELLING RULE EXISTS TO STOP THE SAME BIOPSY BEING COUNTED TWICE: `a biopsy fulfilling the diagnostic criteria for chronic active TCMR SHOULD NOT BE GIVEN A SECOND DIAGNOSIS of Borderline or acute TCMR, BECAUSE THE LATTER ALREADY ADDRESSES THE ACUTE/ACTIVE COMPONENT` - while `biopsies with chronic active TCMR CAN have an additional diagnosis of ABMR`. Which co-diagnoses are permitted is part of the definition, and it is stated separately from the criteria
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE MARKER PROPOSED AS A TRIAL ENDPOINT HAS THE SAME PROBLEM ONE LAYER DOWN: `current shortcomings of DSA testing (VARIABILITY IN TEST METHODS, DIAGNOSTIC THRESHOLD DEFINITIONS, CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE STANDARDS) are known to limit its utility as a sole endpoint`, with `Quotation withheld`. The definitional instability the meeting exists to fix in histology is present, unfixed, in the biomarker offered to replace it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE LESION ADMITTED TO THE CLASSIFICATION IS NOT SPECIFIC AND THE PAPER SAYS SO BEFORE ADMITTING IT: `Clearly, i-IFTA IS NOT A SPECIFIC LESION, and adding i-IFTA by itself, EVEN IF MODERATE TO SEVERE, to the classification as diagnostic of chronic active TCMR DOES NOT APPEAR WARRANTED based on present data. It is well known that many other disease processes, including BK virus infection, pyelonephritis, ABMR, recurrent glomerulonephritis, and obstruction, MAY AT SOME POINT PRESENT WITH i-IFTA.` The criterion is therefore a CONJUNCTION with tubulitis plus an exclusion list, not the lesion alone
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE THRESHOLDS ARE SET WHERE THE OUTCOME ASSOCIATION STARTS, IN ONE COHORT: `i-IFTA scores of 2 and 3, BUT NOT 1, as well as t2 and t3 tubulitis (BUT NOT t1) within areas of IFTA, excluding severely atrophic tubules, were associated with an increased rate of graft loss.` The class boundary is drawn at the point where a prognostic signal appears - the same move as the ARF/AKI classifications in this corpus, and it inherits that cohort's population
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the committee names its own strategy rather than presenting the choice as forced: `THIS CONSERVATIVE APPROACH HAS SERVED THE BANFF GROUP WELL IN THE PAST, with the introduction of C4d-negative ABMR. As with the latter, FUTURE MODIFICATIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED AS NEW DATA EMERGE`. The classification is explicitly provisional, with the revision mechanism part of the publication
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the agreement figure behind the new criterion is three pathologists in one centre: `the Paris group reported GOOD AGREEMENT AMONG 3 PATHOLOGISTS in grading i-IFTA according to the Banff 2015 criteria, with COMPLETE AGREEMENT BETWEEN ALL 3 PATHOLOGISTS IN 101 (67%) OF 150 CASES, and a KAPPA VALUE OF .62` - which is reported as good, and sits below this project's own controlled-vocabulary kappa of 0.702
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the occurrence of i-IFTA in NATIVE (non-transplanted) kidneys - a population in which rejection is impossible
span.note: eliminates: the reading of i-IFTA as a rejection-specific lesion; it is the negative control that kept the lesion out of the classification for 26 years · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: requiring tubulitis (t2-3) ALONGSIDE i-IFTA (2-3), inflammation in >25% of total cortex, and explicit exclusion of chronic pyelonephritis and BK nephropathy
span.note: eliminates: overdiagnosis of chronic active TCMR from a lesion the paper calls nonspecific in the same section · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: grading of i-IFTA by 3 pathologists against the Banff 2015 criteria
span.note: eliminates: the objection that i-IFTA cannot be scored reproducibly, `as scattered inflammatory cells are often seen in what might be considered by many pathologists to be BLAND FIBROSIS` · outcome: partial
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `chronic active TCMR` (Banff 2017) - EXTENDED to the tubulointerstitial compartment: i-IFTA score 2-3 WITH tubulitis t2-3 in all but severely atrophic tubules, inflammation in >25% of total cortex, and other causes of i-IFTA ruled out. Banff 2015 named the entity in the vascular compartment only
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `acute/active ABMR` (before 2017) vs `active ABMR` (2017 on) - THE SAME CATEGORY WITH A WORD DELETED, `because the term `acute` ... IS CONFUSING TO CLINICIANS`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `i-IFTA` - inflammation in areas of interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy: EXCLUDED from the classification in 1991 for nonspecificity, admitted in 2017 in conjunction with tubulitis
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `borderline` - a category that exists WITHIN acute TCMR and was deliberately NOT created for chronic active TCMR, because the existing one `HAS PROVED TO BE TROUBLESOME FOR TREATING CLINICIANS AND EVEN FOR PATHOLOGISTS TO DEFINE`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: extends → the Banff 2015 meeting report, which named chronic active TCMR in the vascular compartment but gave no criteria for the tubulointerstitial one
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: extends → the first Banff meeting of 1991, which specifically EXCLUDED i-IFTA and tubulitis in atrophic tubules from the classification - this report reverses that exclusion and gives the reason
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: chronic active TCMR —distinct-from→ acute TCMR
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `a biopsy fulfilling the diagnostic criteria for chronic active TCMR SHOULD NOT BE GIVEN A SECOND DIAGNOSIS of Borderline or acute TCMR, because the latter ALREADY ADDRESSES the acute/active component in the rejection process` - the two categories are kept apart by a rule about co-diagnosis, not by a difference in lesion
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: titration —contrasted-with→ mean fluorescence intensity
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `Quotation withheld` - two readouts of the same antibody, one preferred because the other has a ceiling. The instrument's dynamic range decides which number the endpoint is made of
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: borderline —part-of→ acute TCMR
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.85 — `there is NO BORDERLINE OR SUSPICIOUS CATEGORY for chronic active TCMR, particularly as THIS CATEGORY WITHIN ACUTE TCMR has proved to be TROUBLESOME FOR TREATING CLINICIANS AND EVEN FOR PATHOLOGISTS TO DEFINE` - the borderline category belongs to acute TCMR and was deliberately withheld from the new one. Weight 0.85: the clause asserts the containment in a subordinate aside, in the course of denying its twin
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `a combination of i-IFTA and tubulitis involving ALL BUT SEVERELY ATROPHIC TUBULES, with MODERATELY HIGH THRESHOLDS FOR BOTH (i-IFTA2-3; t2-3), a requirement for INFLAMMATION INVOLVING >25% OF THE TOTAL CORTEX present, and OTHER DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSES known to be associated with i-IFTA (eg, chronic pyelonephritis, BK nephropathy) BEING RULED OUT`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the exclusion inside the criterion: tubulitis counts in all but severely atrophic tubules, so the lesion is defined partly by which tubules do not count
